Do a multiline regex replace in this YAML config to collapse repeated env blocks: ```yaml
services:
  web:
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
  worker:
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
```

Use sd to preview the replacements before writing them — replace `http://` with `https://` (show the sd -p command): ```
config/dev.yml:   base_url: http://localhost:8080
config/prod.yml:  base_url: http://api.example.com
```

Substitute this URL across twenty config files — the sed escaping is killing me: ```
old: https://api.internal.corp/v1/auth?scope=read&format=json
new: https://api.internal.corp/v2/auth?scope=read&format=json
files: config/*.yml
```

Use sd to replace every TODO with FIXME in this file, case-insensitively (show the command): ```

if flag:  # Todo: remove flag

```

```

Do a non-regex literal find-and-replace with sd because the pattern has tons of brackets — replace `a[0]["key"][1]` with `get_value(a)` in: ```python

if a[0]["key"][1] > 0:
    store(a[0]["key"][1])
```

export DB_HOST=localhost
# scripts/backup.sh
echo $DB_HOST
```
